title: Shared prefixes are recomputed: 9 of 13 family members missed the cache
body: Over the last minute, requests that share a prompt prefix (e.g. the agentic family, 10 requests) reused only 69% of the shared tokens. Prefix caching is on; misses mean the prefix was evicted under memory pressure, or sessions landed on replicas that never saw it.
predicted: Prefix reuse ≥ 90%: TTFT for those requests drops by roughly the prefill time of the shared part
